f.title: Implement the Addendum II masking instructions as soon as possible and within a reasonable timeframe
f.statement: Senders of ICSRs to EudraVigilance should implement the personal data masking instructions of GVP Module VI Addendum II as soon as possible and within a reasonable timeframe.
f.clause: Cover page – Date for coming into effect (footnote *)
f.applicability: Addendum date for coming into effect: 25 July 2025 (cover page)
f.processes: E2B / transmission; Safety system configuration; Regulatory intelligence

rows.deadline: As soon as possible and within a reasonable timeframe

rows.location: Cover page – Date for coming into effect (footnote *)
rows.review_note: Review: removed the added wording that the timeframe runs 'after' the date of coming into effect (source states no start point); kept Recommended ('should'). f.title: Document the implementation timeframe for the masking instructions in internal procedures
f.statement: Senders of ICSRs should document, as part of their internal procedures, the timeframe within which they will implement the Addendum II masking instructions, to demonstrate when and how implementation will be achieved.
f.clause: Cover page – Date for coming into effect (footnote *)
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Validation & change control; Audit & inspection readiness

f.title: Comply with the Addendum II masking instructions for all ICSRs sent to EudraVigilance
f.statement: All senders of ICSRs to EudraVigilance are expected to comply with the instructions set out in GVP Module VI Addendum II on masking of personal data in ICSRs.
f.clause: VI.Add.II.1. Introduction
f.processes: E2B / transmission; Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: All senders of ICSRs to EudraVigilance

f.title: Do not mask or omit ICSR data fields beyond those described in Addendum II
f.statement: The ICSR data fields that senders mask or do not provide should not go beyond the data fields described in GVP Module VI Addendum II.

f.processes: E2B / transmission; Safety system configuration; ICSR quality control

f.title: Leave the 11 sender name and contact fields blank in ICSRs to EudraVigilance
f.statement: The 11 data elements in Table VI.Add.II.2 (sender title, given, middle and family name, street address, city, state or province, postcode, country code, telephone and fax) are not necessary for signal management, duplicate detection or ICSR processing. Because nullFlavors are not supported for these elements in the ICH E2B(R3) guideline, the sender should always leave them blank when submitting ICSRs to EudraVigilance.
